if you get the wrong pets or you focus on the wrong ones in your first run it will be a grindfest to get the first ascension done. with a higher than 60hz refresh rate monitor: "V-sync", and "FPS Limit above 60" make my gpu go a bit crazy. for an idle game you have to be way to active, if you don't have the right pets or ascension upgrades, with no meaningful/impactful things to do, you have to spend your GP, your SP, equip gear, spawn bosses, sell fishes, so there is way to less automation. also you can't automate everthing you want, some things just don't have it. most things you do feel like they have little impact and it feels very linear. on new ascension you feel like you start the game new bc you have to regain your pets and points so you are very slow again, while you was almost flying throug it before ascension. the Home Screen feels very odd, you have to be offline or idling at that screen to get dreamsand, but while on this screen the game itself does not progress at all, so it is the same as you where offline, makes absolute no sense to me. and to get sand while online you again need a specific pet for that.

[h1]《Siegeturtle》：在挂机中变强，带海龟回家吧~[/h1] 这一款海龟为主角的挂机游戏，将角色扮演游戏之中各类经典的养成机制，包括属等级、属性、技能、同伴、装备、死亡、升天等等，都融入到了本作的挂机内容之中。玩家想要让海龟走的距离越远，那就必须使用各种途径想方设法的培养海龟的战力，而海龟培养所消耗的资源，基本都是在挂机中一点点的累积慢慢获得的。这个过程没有捷径，只能熬时间，熬着熬着也就变强了，这非常的挂机游戏。 [h1]海龟主角的归家之路[/h1] 大海充满了野兽。没人知道它们为什么要阻止你回家，但你必须坚持并变得更强。 当你打败第一个啃兵时，你感到成就感。但这些生物究竟是什么? 你开始从这些啃兵身上找到装备，但它们似乎不适合你或任何已知的海洋生物。 你决定给自己设定一些想象中的目标以保持动力，仅仅想到达成成就就让你感觉更强。 你发现自己可以潜水并在水下呼吸，虽然你是一只海龟，但你不确定为什么之前从没试过。无论如何，捕鱼或许能赚点外快。 你已经越过了中途点，你几乎能尝到家的味道--哦，等等，那只是海水。 这些装备赋予了你力量——你没有质疑它们的力量，但你确实想知道它们从何而来，以及它们最初的用途是什么。 你终于到达了家！你原本很期待能遇到其他海龟，但奇怪的是，一个也没有，你从一路结识的同伴中获得安慰……但被你击败的啃兵掉落了一块珊瑚，你要碰它吗? …… [h1]俺想要变强，那就挂个机吧[/h1] 海龟的主要变强道路，主要以下方的六项强化内容为主，搭配其它的一些玩法，共同让咱家的海龟变得越来越强。 第一，死亡奖励，海龟每次死亡之后，都可以随机获得一次升级卡片，包括金币、伤害、防御、移速、最大生命值、生命回复速率等等。 第二，基础属性，消耗金币给六项基础属性加点，包括力量、体力、生命回复速率、攻击速度、MP（最大MP和MP恢复速度）、暴击伤害等。 第三，升级点数，获得升级点数，为相关项目加点，包括伤害、最大生命值和生命回复速率、金币、所有统计数据等四个项目。 第四，装备，击杀敌人会概率掉落一些武器装备，目前版本共有11个装备部位。 第五，技能，包括12个主动技能（消耗SP点数升级）、37个被动技能（消耗SP点数升级）以及23个升天技能（消耗珊瑚点数升级）。 第六，同伴，每击败一个啃兵将随机抽取同伴，同伴不仅可以解锁相关的哨兵技能，同时也能提高一些增益效果。 以上仅仅只是海龟主角变强的途径，实际上游戏之中还有其余的诸多内容，玩法包括钓鱼、梦幻岛、Boss地下城、升天（类似于转生）等等，货币（消耗）类包括金币、暗物质、暗珍珠、闪亮珍珠、梦幻沙、紫砂、分片、技能点（SP）、属性点（GP）、珊瑚、精华等。 上述的内容，无论是角色的成长、战斗，还是钓鱼、梦幻岛，基本都和挂机有关，玩家只有挂得时间长，才能够变强，才能够让自家的海龟走的越来越远，距离回家的道路越来越近。不过，这一条挂机的道路，非常的漫长，海龟的成长速度，异常的缓慢，加油吧，海龟，挂机吧，骚年。 [quote]关注鉴赏组：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45134494]浮生评测[/url] ←"浮生若梦，一鉴倾心，邀您共赏人间烟火" 加入Steam组：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LLFLLFF]浮生评测[/url]←“一起追寻'浮生若梦'般的游戏体验” 开始“浮生若梦”鉴赏组的奇幻之旅！[/quote]

I’ve been playing SiegeTurtle for a while now, and honestly this game is way better than I expected. The progression feels rewarding, the combat is fun and smooth, and the weapon variety makes every run feel different. The art style is cute, the animations are clean, and the difficulty curve is just right — challenging but not frustrating. I really enjoy the sense of growth as the turtle gets stronger and the maps open up. The game definitely has a lot of potential, and I’m excited to see where the developers will take it! Strongly recommended to anyone who likes roguelike or survival shooter style games. Solid 5 stars from me! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
很耐玩，就是很多技能的中文翻译看不懂，比如繁荣不知道加的什么属性
升级路线很有趣。但是简中翻译还有很多问题。 比如超级暴击的说明两段是一样的，应该翻译成超级暴击和终极暴击之类的，而不是两段都是超级暴击。 还有蜜蜂蜇伤技能，越升级减伤的比例越低，后面的刺伤每升一级+1点。如果刺伤是单次伤害的话，这个技能升级的收益很不合理，越升级收益越低。 如果是蜇伤次数的话还能理解，但501级以后-1%的蜇伤刺501次，却比500级-3%的蜇伤刺500次收益低，很不合理。

I really enjoy this game and its playloop. I have one thing against it. The dust system for offline is very, very lacking compared to just providing resources like gold and exp. If the dust was ALL permanent, then yes. But it isn't. So this game is great. But I mostly recommend it to those who can leave a game open and running all the time.

Sure, it's cute, cheap, and the dev gives it constant updates, usually very small, but updates nonetheless. So why don't I recommend Siegeturtle? Because it's a mobile game on pc. Siegeturtle is the kind of game you would download on your phone to kill the half hour in the waiting room at the doctor's office, then delete it immediately after the appointment. It plays itself for the most part, you click on upgrades to slightly increase the turtle's power, each enemy the turtle beats produces a few coins, and you repeat this cycle ad nauseum. It's literally the same formula used for thousands of phone games, but on mobile you pay to not have ads. It wouldn't surprise me one bit if this game is eventually on the play store for a few bucks in the near future.

Cute game, tons of potential. Onboarding falls off fairly quickly, requiring you to go to the discord to try to figure out what's wrong, and that's unfortunately where things fall apart. Sometimes they're vaguely helpful, and sometimes it's like pulling teeth. The community isn't toxic, but I found it frustrating to try to talk to them. One fellow kept trying to tell me the translations were the issue. I really want to like this game. At for the price, maybe it's worth getting. But hitting a wall, having no clue how to solve it, going to the discord, being told I put my points into the wrong then, making some progress, then running into another wall and being told that the game doesn't have or need build, except that if you put your points wrong, you'll get stuck until you eventually have enough points that you get over that wall without understanding why. Yeah, just not a great experience. Having so many mechanics locked behind really cute pets that you can only get at the mini bosses every 50 levels, until you reach a miniboss you can't get past, so you can't get more of those, including some that woud help you get past this mechanic, that's fairly frustrating. And the boss that guards the ascension mechanic is a steep difficulty spike. The MP mechanics are rough. There's a buff that massively increases your MP regen, but no way to set buff priorities. So sometimes a different buff will cast, drain my MP, so I can't cast the buff that would maintain the MP. And the only way to tweak the MP costs of something are to lower how many points you've put into it. Which is on a screen that covers the MP bar and can't be moved, preventing you from seeing the impact of the changes you are making when you are trying to tune the MP expenses. And even if you do tune them, there are some abilities that only trigger on bosses, which means your tuning will be wrong for the bosses, where it matters. But no, the game doesn't need builds, according to the community, despite there being SP farming builds, gold farming builds, etc. Especially since the SP farming build is based on maxing your speed for the early content of the run, then dying as soon as possible when your speed drops, which is a little counter-intuitive and probably wouldn't be something most people would stumble over. And if you overspend on boosts to your health, you have to employ another counter-intuitive strategy to fix the issue.

这个游戏一点也不休闲，不放置，每次转生都要选几十个宠，每个宠对应一个技能还要手动升级，下面的自动升级技能却不给自动进阶技能。是故意的还是故意的，也真是无语。（如果你有耐力重复这样的操作无数次，那么这就是个好游戏，或者直接修改，不然呢？） 简单来说 开局地狱难度 选错伙伴不管你挂多少个小时，挂一年也没提升，直接重玩就完事 努力后 你打到500关了，开始飞升（500到1000关是最轻松的时间） 更努力后 你打到1000关了，噩梦开始（你必须最低打到1000关才能飞升） 地狱玩法 你无限努力后，可以十分钟就打到第1000关了，你还想提升？抱歉没那么轻松，你现在就完全是个机器人一样，需要刷1000关就完事 你想1100？打十分钟到1000，想1100那么再来10分钟，收益提升10%，想1200再来60分钟，收益提升20% 对的，你没看错，你努力了更多时间，收益提升却更低 无奈的你最终如何选择？ 开挂？作弊？ 或者像个傻子一样每次都要手法选40个伙伴，手动升级40个技能？在短短的十分钟内无限循环？
不推荐，相对于其他很多放置游戏来说，纯纯的数值限制。 挂机飞升后，那个移动速度，我都不知道爽点在哪？？？ 且这技能系统设计不合理，有些东西是分段式，但更多的则是边际效应极其明显的凑数技能，纯纯浪费时间。不清楚的时候拿了垃圾宠物，痛苦一局。 看似选择很多，实际各种卡你提升。 评价路边一条。

0. SLOWLY do several runs to gain skill points and unlock basic skills and companions while earning 5 coral before your first ascension. But you won't earn any coral until you reach level 500. 1. Beat the ascension challenges to unlock additional ascension upgrade paths. Which requires you to spend more corals, even though you're still only earning enough corals per ascension to get maybe 2 upgrades each time. 2. Before you reach stage 1000 it is just a real slog, slow grind, takes FOREVER. 3. After stage 1000 it is STILL a real slog, slow grind, takes FOREVER... but the EARLY part of your runs will get faster/easier if you've chosen the right ascension upgrades and the right companion skills. 4. However, with each ascension you won't earn any corals for an additional 50 stages compared to your last run. Yes, at the end of this run you still EARN those corals starting at stage 500, but you can't actually ascend to collect them until 50 levels later for each ascension. This is not a game you "play." This is a game you leave running in the background and let your PC play with itself while you're not looking. For several weeks straight. Then you come back and spend five minutes spending all your skill points, then let it run for another week. Then you come back and spend 10 more minutes on skill points. Let it run itself for another week, then you'll find that you're not making any more progress even with massive skill points which means it's time for another ascension. Setup a new challenge run as you ascend. Unlock two or three ascension skill levels, then you're out of coral again so repeat the cycle.

It's not a bad game per se, there's just not enough to it. This is one of those idle games that's meant to become part of your daily routine. You start it up in the morning, get your offline progress + currency, "catch up", then close it and wait for the offline progress to do 98% of the work for you, rinse, repeat. This wouldn't be the worst thing in the world, but the entire progress in itself isn't very satisfying. It's very easy to get stuck multiple times and be unable to figure out what you're doing wrong with your build. It doesn't help that companion choices matter and, as a new player, you have no idea what's actually going to be useful or not. You'd think keeping yourself alive and pushing forward further and further would make the most sense, except actual meta progress happens when you die and collect your skill points, so the [i]actual[/i] most important skill you can get is movement speed so you can get back to where you died the fastest so you can die again and collect skill points again to respawn and invest those points into more speed to get back to where you died even faster and.... It feels like there's a meta strategy, or even multiple, to this game that can only be found through trial and error as guides are scarce but I have no interest in joining a Discord server just to rely on other people to teach me how to play [b]an idle game[/b]. I want to be fair to the dev and say again that this isn't a bad game, it's just simply not for me.

Progress slows to a halt approaching meter 200, and offline bonuses only apply after meter 300. Thus, the only way to keep going is to let this game run in the background of your computer for extremely long periods of time. Does that scream "fun" to you? Progression is punished in multiple ways. First you lose access to the quest system. Then you can no longer get a boost from companions. Then you run out of death "cards". Then runs no longer generate enough income to buy incremental upgrades, meaning you have to depend on skill points (SP), which also become incrementally more expensive, and depend on you dying, which takes longer and longer to happen because 90% of the way to meter 200 is blockaded by low level enemies that give practically no rewards. I don't want this game running in the back of my computer. I'd rather just play a real game. There is nothing to do, and nothing to see here. It's just a waste of time.

Fun little longer idle game, actually some really tough choices with companions and overtime you'll learn that some are way stronger than they seem. Ways to cater to longer or shorter playstyles. Once you finish challenges you've seen the content, there is a nice little end screen once you unlock hidden power and if you just like the game there is a LOT more scaling you can do after you reach "end game". I plan to just keep it running and keep scaling up as that's fun to me. One thing I will say, I think the butterflies are basically useless for 99% of players. I almost feel they should unlock after you unlock hidden power as another way to scale end game, but overall really great little game.

I've played a number of idle games, but I've never encountered an idle game that encourages failure. You can increase your farm rate by intentionally lowering your health and farming an in-game "currency" called skill points. On top of that, this game lacks any depth at all. You hit a wall at 300, repeat the same ♥♥♥♥ until 900, then ascend, and repeat. Additionally, there is a AFK island where you get currency for being offline. You can either progress there or in the main game, and the points you gather there disappears upon ascending. Once again, what's the point of this mechanism? TL;DR Pointless, boring, and honestly quite uninteresting. I'm not sure how it has gotten a "Very Positive" review.
画面简陋，玩法还行，非常低配的办公机（一些优化差的挂机游戏都挂不了）都能运行，上班挂着玩儿的。

At its heart this is your typical get stronger, prestige, restart, rinse and repeat ad nausea game with a cute cover. However, once you get to a certain point the cost of prestige quickly outpaces how fast you can attain the currency to do so. Not only that, but certain achievements are made for getting beyond the 5000M point with ease, which just isn't easy. I get it, that is the point to draw out the length of the game, but at some point the drag isn't worth the prize simply because the astronomical cost of certain types of upgrades meant to help achieve that final prize. The developer seems to have significantly slowed on doing any further changes to the game at this point also, to include not even cleaning off the leader boards of obvious cheaters. Some of the ingame mechanics still aren't explained well meaning that if you don't ask questions (and hopefully get an answer from other players) don't expect the game to explain it to you. I say this after nearly 700 hours of play time, 99% of both ingame and steam achievements, and watching the utter fall off in further development/updates in the last 6 months. It's a cute game, it might scratch an itch, but if you are a completionist then i would steer clear of this one as it doesn't seem to be going anywhere any time soon.

The early~middle game was fun while doing challenge runs. After finishing those it fell to the classic "lets prestige over and over to break this timewall" design issues. The biggest insult was the super anticlimatic hidden power reveal that showed... more prestiges, more timewalls, same old grind. Fairly harshly capped offline progress without companions combined with all the dust vanishing without prestige upgrades made me not use it at all after few cheap upgrades. Fun game until a point but can't recommend.
